verdict.rationale: Checkout.com offers building blocks that support background automation — webhooks trigger server-side actions on payment lifecycle events, and the MCP server lets an AI agent query statuses, issue refunds, and manage payment links — plus agentic commerce protocols (ChatGPT, Google AI) letting an AI complete transactions on a user's behalf. However, none of this constitutes a dedicated 'set up an automation that runs autonomously in the background' capability (e.g., scheduled jobs, persistent agent workflows); the MCP server is described as an IDE-session tool, not an unattended background process. Missing for 10: a documented scheduler/background-job or persistent autonomous-agent workflow feature, and independent evidence of such automations running unattended.
